in_marathi.name: गोलू
in_marathi.long_meaning: गोलू हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name गोलू is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘गोल’, meaning ‘Moon’. The suffix ‘ू’ adds a circular or spherical meaning, symbolizing the Moon’s shape. In Hindu mythology, the Moon is considered a powerful deity and is believed to influence tides, emotions, and growth.
